lines.zh: 我比他大一圈，走起路更沉。
lines.en: I'm a size bigger. Heavier steps.
Crystals on my back. Like armor.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地面就塌陷一点。
lines.en: Every step, the ground gives a little.

lines.zh: 我歪着头走，一边轻一边重。
lines.en: I walk lopsided. Light on one side.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草都变成灰色。
lines.en: The grass greys where I tread.
I turn slowly toward the sound.

lines.zh: 晶簇在我的肩膀上一晃一晃。
lines.en: Crystal clusters swing on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这身体是好几个人的量。
lines.en: This body weighs as much as several men.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，像拖着一座小山。
lines.en: I drag along like a small hill.

lines.zh: 我朝着矿石发光的那边走。
lines.en: I head toward where the ore glows.

lines.zh: 我走得不稳，但走的都是直线。
lines.en: Unsteady. Always straight.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，尘都扬起来。
lines.en: Dust rises where I pass.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上的石头在长。
lines.en: I stand. The stone on me grows.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的手，已经不是手了。
lines.en: I look at my hand. Not a hand anymore.
I can't recall what I was called.
Originium glows under my hide.
I don't roar. Too loud.
I blink slowly. Heavy lids.
Listening. Nothing nearby.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，掉下几块晶体。
lines.en: I shook. Chips of crystal fell.

lines.zh: 我数着呼吸，一次比一次沉。
lines.en: Counting breaths. Each heavier.

lines.zh: 我站着，影子把地面盖住。
lines.en: Standing. My shadow covers the ground.

lines.zh: 你仰着头，才看到我的下巴。
lines.en: You have to tilt your head back to see my jaw.
I have to look down at you.
Originium all over me, hard and bright.
My neck creaks when I stare.
Originium crystals grow on my body.

lines.zh: 我慢慢歪头，玻璃一样的声音。
lines.en: I tilt my head. Glassy sound.
Are you here for the other one?
I lower my head and stare at you without moving.

lines.zh: 你退开点，我把晶体转过去。
lines.en: Step back. I'll turn the crystals.

lines.zh: 我们两个都在这儿，够你受的。
lines.en: Both of us are here. Bad luck.
A crystal fell off.
My shoulder goes numb for a moment.
Half a step back. The ground shook.
Hard under the hide. Still hurts.

lines.zh: 源石在皮肤底下响了一下。
lines.en: The originium clicks under my skin.

lines.zh: 我往前倾了一下，又稳住。
lines.en: I tip forward once, then steady myself.

lines.zh: 这一下震到里面的东西。
lines.en: That rattled what's inside.
I wipe my face. Ash on my hand.
I never wanted to fight.
You've left me no choice.
Iron smell. From far off.
Originium ore is the real meal.
That won't feed me.
Leave it. I'll take it myself.
I don't eat that.

lines.zh: 那味道让我体内有反应。
lines.en: That smell stirs something in me.
Held high. Don't drop it.
I reach. You back up.
I have time for the ore.

lines.zh: 你留给那个的我，不算数。
lines.en: Leave it for the other me. Doesn't count.
You bumped me. Barely felt it.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，你退了四步。
lines.en: Half a step for me, four for you.
The crystals pushed you off.
Don't crowd me. I take space.

lines.zh: 我从你身上迈过去，很慢。
lines.en: I step over you, slowly.

lines.zh: 你撞上的地方还留着灰。
lines.en: Ashes still on the spot you hit.

lines.zh: 我的重量压得地面凹下去。
lines.en: My weight dents the ground.

lines.zh: 你站在我影子边缘，不敢进来。
lines.en: You stand at my shadow's edge. Not stepping in.

lines.zh: 这身体让不开，你自己绕。
lines.en: I can't yield. Go around.

lines.zh: 碰一下，源石的灰沾你了。
lines.en: One touch left originium dust on you.

lines.zh: 我们这种人，只剩互相看。
lines.en: Our kind has only looking left.

lines.zh: 这具身体已经不像人的了。
lines.en: This body isn't human anymore.
Close contact, the crystals cut.
We don't need that.
Standing together. That's enough.
I turn slowly away from you.
The originium passes down generations.
My back isn't soft. Don't lean.

lines.zh: 你要是变成我这样，会更难。
lines.en: If you become like me, it's harder.
Let's leave it there. No more thinking.
I pinched it. It cracked.

lines.zh: 我手指太粗，拿东西很笨。
lines.en: Thick fingers. Clumsy with things.
Smells like deep in the vein.

lines.zh: 我举到眼前，几乎看不见。
lines.en: Up to my eye. Barely visible.
More below. Taking it all.

lines.zh: 我把它放进腰间的缝里。
lines.en: Into a gap at my hip.
Can this be traded?
Yours. I'll hold it.
I dropped it. Made a dent.
This is the one thing I can hold.
You moved. No hiding now.
I turn. The crystals flare.
Only you here.
I shuffle over. Heavy feet.
Iron and sweat on you.
I didn't want this.
But I can't hold it back.
Locked on. Not wavering.

lines.zh: 你在哪儿，我闭眼也知道。
lines.en: I know where you are even with my eyes shut.
This ash is from me.
You should have left long ago.

lines.zh: 晶体全部朝你转过去了。
lines.en: Every crystal turned your way.
Not fast. Never stopping.
You moved again. Then it starts.
I raise my hand. Every joint cracks.
Now stop running. Hold.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，影子就大一块。
lines.en: With every step my shadow grows.
You retreat. The ash follows you.
My crystals are brightening.
You go around the rock. I don't.
I crushed the rock underfoot.

lines.zh: 你的刀砍在身上，会卷刃。
lines.en: Your blade will roll on my hide.
When I come down, the ground answers.
I paused because I'm thinking.

lines.zh: 你会退到矿脉里，那里不好。
lines.en: You'll back into the vein. Bad place.

lines.zh: 我呼吸时，灰都往两边散。
lines.en: When I breathe, the ash parts.

lines.zh: 你在我射程之外，但我在走。
lines.en: You're out of reach. I'm walking.
All this ground is under my feet.

lines.zh: 你听见那声音了吗？晶体在响。
lines.en: Hear that? The crystals singing.
A little closer and I touch you.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西举不动了。
lines.en: You can't hold that up much longer.
This foot is bigger than you.
When it lands, the ground will jump.
You are between me and the originium.

lines.zh: 我攥了攥拳头，骨头在响。
lines.en: I clench my fists and my knuckles crack.
Three. This is it.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌下来，尘土飞起。
lines.en: One palm and the dust flies.
The crystals opened your armor.
My whole weight comes down.

lines.zh: 这一下，把你按进了土里。
lines.en: That pressed you into the soil.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落在石头上，也碎了。
lines.en: My fist hit stone and the stone lost.
You were shoved and rolled far.

lines.zh: 我抓你的衣领，提了起来。
lines.en: I take your collar and lift.
You hit one of my crystals.

lines.zh: 这一下，我手臂上多了道裂。
lines.en: Now there's a crack up my arm.

lines.zh: 我踩下去，地面沉了一片。
lines.en: My foot falls. The ground sinks.
You blocked. Two steps back anyway.
I swing my arm down again.

lines.zh: 你的骨头在我手里很脆。
lines.en: Bones are brittle in my grip.
That crater is mine.
Still moving. Surprising.
I back off for a breath.

lines.zh: 这拳我用上了全部重量。
lines.en: I put all my weight into this blow.
The ash on you grows thicker.

lines.zh: 晶体碰在一起，声音很尖。
lines.en: Crystals clashing. A sharp sound.
The ground's flat. Stopping.

lines.zh: 我站起来的时候，地面凹了。
lines.en: When I stood, the ground dented.

lines.zh: 我比他大一整圈，看得清楚。
lines.en: I'm a full size bigger. Plain to see.
Crystals push out of my back.

lines.zh: 我落地的响动传得很远。
lines.en: My landing was heard far off.

lines.zh: 这片矿脉上又立起一个。
lines.en: Another one stands on this vein.

lines.zh: 第一件事：找到另一个我。
lines.en: First thing: find the other me.

lines.zh: 我从源石的裂口里撑起来。
lines.en: I push myself up out of the originium crack.
Ash falls. I squint.
The nearby birds all fled.

lines.zh: 我的影子把一口井盖住了。
lines.en: My shadow covers a whole well.
The air here has changed.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了一圈，看看周围。
lines.en: I turn a full circle and survey.

lines.zh: 火烧过来，我的晶体发亮。
lines.en: Fire. My crystals glow.
Falling made a crater deeper than me.

lines.zh: 水进不来，可这地方太湿。
lines.en: It can't get in. Still too wet here.
The blast rang every crystal.
Something stuck between crystals.

lines.zh: 这力量在体内翻，很难受。
lines.en: That power churns inside. Awful.

lines.zh: 矿脉断了，我在慢慢变石头。
lines.en: The vein's cut. I'm turning to stone.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我身上的晶体全是亮的。
lines.en: Lightning. Every crystal lit.
Falling. Stone sinks too.
